'''2007 Massachusetts State Championship Mark Neumann DS Carbon Chamber Testing''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Mark Neumann]] at [[2007 Massachusetts State Championship]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Carbon Chamber Testing / My Favorite Decoration|SE-D-carbonchambertesting.gif}}
* '''Name on sheet:''' Mark A. N... (surname faint; possibly Neumann)
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS12]]
